newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm as Yeltsin reappears.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm as Yeltsin reappears.

text.p: Russian MinFin bonds firmed in lively trading on Monday, with the market buoyed by the re-appearance of President Boris Yeltsin, dealers said.

"The West started buying already on Friday, after seeing Yeltsin in good shape. Russian banks seemed to be covering short positions in early trading today before profit-taking started," one dealer said.
Dealers said the most actively traded fourth and fifth tranches had run into resistance at 64.50-64.60 and 45.70-45.75 respectively.
"Prices firmed earlier about 0.5 point but then selling started mainly in the West... The market has calmed down and few deals are being struck now," Avtobank dealer Alla Zakharova said.
She added the 2003 maturity was suffering the main pressure.
